gloss: to lay down; to let age/rest

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {寝|ね}かせていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to put to bed, to lay down
definitions.explanation: To put someone (especially a child) to bed, or to lay something flat.

definitions.gloss: to let age, to let rest, to let sit
definitions.explanation: To leave food, drink, or dough for a period of time to develop flavor, ferment, or reach the right consistency.

examples.english: To put the child to bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寝|ね}かせた。
examples.english: The baby finally fell asleep, so I gently laid it down on the futon.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボトル→ボトル：11270_botoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寝|ね}かせて⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: Store the bottle on its side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧{寝|ね}かせる。
⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{寝|ね}かせた⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Curry tastes better when left to sit for a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{寝|ね}かせて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まっている→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: When you open wine after aging it for many years, the flavor has deepened.

notes:
{寝|ね}かせる is the transitive causative form of ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep). It is an ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pair: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (intransitive — to sleep, to lie down)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝|ね}かせる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子|こ}ども⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝|ね}かせる (to put the child to bed)
- ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝|ね}かせる (to let dough rest)
- ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝|ね}かせる (to age wine)
- ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寝|ね}かせる (to lay on its side)

USAGE:
Sense 2 is widely used in cooking and food preparation. The idea is that letting something rest or age improves it, similar to English "let it sit" or "let it age."
